answer: Each identity binds one bank account: an open-banking attestation proves it is real and at least 180 days old, hashed into the canyon registry; a 25 POA bond locks 90 days. Each quarter a comet sweep re-checks every account: the bank must return a signed echo of the nonce within 72 hours, or payouts freeze and half the bond is lost. One person holds few accounts, so 100 fakes need 100 real ones: at 5 days of KYC each, 500 days of work, and banks flag the 20th duplicate device, so each extra account costs more time and rejections. A household sharing one account gets a 14-day grace proof.
